top_violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This was evaluated during a DFPS investigation and found to be deficient.

top_violation_types.title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The van for transportation does not have a child safety alarm equipped.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 10 children were missing special care needs information in their admission paperwork.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric first aid.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Director did not have a current transportation training.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §746.801(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Multiple record keeping items were not made available to the Child Care Regulation Inspector for review at the time of the monitoring inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Copy of the most current sanitation inspection report was not available to review at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric CPR.
